why: Nobody answers the shopper's actual question, which is a list: every page is single-brand (QNAP product/store pages, UGREEN support), a single-product review (Macworld tests only the TBS-h574TX), a general NAS roundup (TechRadar), or an affiliate video-editing listicle. The two niche pages that compile models each cover one brand with specs and no testing. Borderline toward contested because Macworld is a real tested review of a TB4-for-Mac NAS, but a focused cross-brand page with prices, Mac caveats and a direct pick would be the only source answering the question as asked.
